title: Delivery promise
text: Every ShopNova order has a promised delivery date, shown to the client at checkout. The order should arrive on or before that date. An order delivered after the promised date, or not delivered when the promised date has passed, is late; the number of days late is computed by the system.

title: Late delivery of 1 to 5 days
text: If an order is 1 to 5 days late and not yet delivered, apologise to the client, give the current delivery status from the tracking data, and offer a notification when the order is shipped, out for delivery or delivered. No refund or compensation is given for a delay of 5 days or less.

title: Full refund for a delay of more than 5 days
text: If an order is more than 5 days late and still not delivered, the client may ask for a full refund of the amount paid. The refund is given only if the client asks for it; the order is then cancelled.

title: Refund limit
text: A refund can never be higher than the amount the client actually paid for the order, minus any refund already given or approved for that order. An order that was already fully refunded cannot be refunded again. For a cash-on-delivery order that is not yet paid, the amount paid is 0 TND, so no refund is possible.

title: Returns within 14 days
text: A delivered item can be returned within 14 days of the delivery date if it is unused and in its original packaging. The refund is paid after ShopNova receives the returned item.

title: Damaged item
text: If a client says an item arrived damaged, ask for a photo of the damage. Only after the photo proof is received can a replacement or a refund be offered.

title: Large refunds need finance approval
text: Any refund above 300 TND must be approved by the ShopNova finance team (Layer 3) before it is paid. Do not promise the client a refund above 300 TND; say that it needs approval.

title: Delivery notifications
text: A client can subscribe to a notification for an order. Notifications exist only for these events: shipped, out for delivery, delivered. Promise a notification only after the subscription is recorded.

title: Cancelling an order
text: An order can be cancelled while it is still being processed (not yet shipped). If it was paid, the full amount paid is refunded.

title: Replacement for an urgent need
text: When a client urgently needs an item of an order that is late or arrived damaged (photo received), ShopNova may send a replacement of that item from its stock, as a new order at no cost. The replacement is offered only if the product is in stock, the order was not refunded or cancelled, and the client says yes to it. One replacement per order.
condition: in_order and stock >= qty and not status in ['refunded', 'cancelled'] and (days_late > 0 or proof_received)

title: Hold an item for a client
text: ShopNova may keep (hold) units of a product in stock for a client for at most 3 days, for example while an urgent problem with their order is solved. A hold is made only if enough stock is left and the client says yes to it. Held units are not sold to others during the hold.

title: Special help from a colleague
text: A hard or disputed case (the client disagrees with a decision, the case was sent back several times, or no rule fits) can be passed to a human colleague of the special help team, with the reason. The request is made only if the client says yes to it.

title: Low stock warning
text: A product is short when 5 units or fewer are left, or when the stock covers less than 14 days of sales at the rate of the last 30 days. The availability team then warns the status team, so clients are not promised items that may run out.

title: Promotion for overstock
text: A product is overstocked when 50 units or more are in stock and the stock covers more than 180 days of sales at the rate of the last 30 days. The availability team may then propose a promotion of at most 20 percent. The shop owner must approve every promotion before it starts; a promotion never changes the price by itself.
